stories.title: Evening recap
stories.summary: Evening recap Good evening, Middle East Eye readers. If you're just joining us, here are key developments from the day: Tehran warned that it would target the interests of any countries that help the US sanctions against Iran, threatening to block oil exports through Hormuz. Israeli attacks across villages in southern Lebanon continued throughout the day. An explosive device detonated on a bus carrying security forces near Damascus. Syrian authorities said an investigation into the attack is underway.
